passages.note: Co-authored bill amends Indiana's existing photo-ID definition to accept REAL ID cards; the photograph requirement stays, so it only widens which photo documents count and sets no rung (annex: amending an existing ID law is not the person's position).
Bill details page showing Pierce as co-author of HB 1339; the bill died at first reading and its operative text only adds REAL ID to accepted photo IDs.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Carolyn Jackson, Rep. Matt Pierce.

passages.note: At a 2026 primary forum he says he objected to removing student IDs as accepted voter ID; student IDs are photo IDs, so this concerns which photo documents count, not where the ladder's rungs differ.
Newsletter explains current Indiana registration requirements to constituents; it describes existing law and states no position on ID rules.
Statement on congressional redistricting (HB 1032); says nothing about voter identification.
Newsletter on the Voting Rights Act and redistricting maps; not about how voters' identity is verified.

rows.reasoning: HB 1339 (2026), which he co-authored, keeps Indiana's photo requirement and only adds REAL ID cards to the accepted documents; it does not choose among "Accept non-photo identification", "Require photo ID ... after signing an affidavit" or the stricter rungs. His forum objection to dropping student IDs also concerns which photo documents count, so no passage reaches a rung's clauses.
